To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) we present a novel coarse to fine correspondence network architecture that achieves the state of art performance on all large scale benchmarks for image matching; 2) we show that the proposed method is able to establish correspondences between images of different domains, such as images of the same object captured in different conditions (day and night) and images captured in different scenes; 3) we show that our method can be used in the real-time domain for 3D localization and SLAM tasks;
we propose a dual-resolution correspondence network that is able to produce dense correspondences in a robust, accurate, and efficient manner.
